items.title: Chris Olave: Questionable for Week 6
items.text:
Olave (illness) was limited at Friday's practice and will be listed as questionable for Week 6.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Lamar Jackson: Ruled out for Sunday's game
items.text:
Head coach Jesse Minter said Friday that the Ravens have ruled out Jackson (ankle) for Sunday's game at Cleveland, Brian Wacker of The Baltimore Sun reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: A.J. Brown: Decision to come Saturday
items.text:
Head coach Mike Vrabel said Friday that the Patriots won't make a call on Brown's (ankle) status for Sunday's game against the Jets until Saturday, Doug Kyed of the Boston Herald reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Michael Penix: Ready for Week 6
items.text:
Penix (ribs) doesn't have a designation for Sunday's game against the Bears, Tori McElhaney of the Falcons' official site reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Jadarian Price: May return in Week 8
items.text:
Head coach Mike Macdonald said Friday that Price "should be looking at a sooner rather than later return after" the Seahawks' next game in Week 7, Brady Henderson of ESPN.com reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.
